page-3-poem.prompt: Colouring book page, pure black line art on a plain white background ... a large Vietnamese conical palm-leaf hat (nón bài thơ) seen from the front ... a woman in a long flowing áo dài dress, a small rowing boat on two gentle waves, and a lotus flower with two round leaves ...

page-4-market.prompt: Very simple colouring book page for 4-6 year olds ... A cheerful Vietnamese street market where everyone wears a big conical nón lá hat: three smiling sellers, one carrying a bamboo shoulder pole with two baskets. The baskets are plain smooth bowls with NO weave pattern ...
page-4-market.why: replaces e426b1ce (≈450 basket-weave cells too small to tap-fill); ≈100 small regions now

rejected.e: e83e7e10-5a20-4442-b58c-832944896605 (umbrella market; simplest but fewer hats)

schoolyard.prompt: Gentle outdoor schoolyard ambience in a Vietnamese town in the morning: distant children chatting and laughing, a few bicycle bells, birds in the trees, soft breeze, a far-off school bell once. Calm, even level, no music, no clear speech, seamless background loop.
schoolyard.post: 1 s equal-power crossfade of tail into head (19 s loop), 48 kHz mono 96 kbps, -24 LUFS

rain-market.source: mix of rain-on-hat (1.0) and market-chatter (0.7), -2.5 dB, 48 kHz mono 96 kbps (no generation)

used.prompt: Paper-cut silhouette artwork for a Vietnamese poem hat (nón bài thơ): solid flat dark-brown cut-paper shapes on a pure white background. A wide, balanced composition: a girl in a flowing áo dài with a nón lá on the left, a sampan boat with a rower on gentle waves in the middle, a lotus flower with round leaves on the right, small birds and a crescent moon above. ...
